about: Gate 92 (TC-HM-057a..d): (a, b) read out of chess.jsx's SKINS, no two skins share their four tile icons or the learn+play badge their Skin row paints; (c) on the Style sheet (Look and feel, then Style) each skin's row is found by name and leads with its own icons; (d) on Home, with each skin chosen through ct_skin for a Pro subscriber (the harness's stand-in; Playful and Medieval are Pro skins), the four tiles found by label paint four glyphs no other skin paints. Rendered halves graded at kunal761 (375x761, insets 51/31) and 320x568 by CT_G92_GEO. NOT COVERED: Discover's tiles (their own job, discover-tile-icons-should-match-each-theme), the Layout readout's ink line, a non-subscriber (who sees Classic's tiles whatever the stored skin), his look on his phone.

breaks.name: classic-takes-playfuls-icons
breaks.why: Classic's SKINS icons go back to Playful's four (the #366 state Kunal reported), so the rows, the Home tiles and the source all match [re-cut at #553 B2, jobs/pairs-break-patches-go-stale-as-later-merges-move-their-context-2026-11-24: since card 92 both skins' Play icon is the pawn, so the break swaps the two icons that still differ, learn and analyze, to Playful's 🔭 and 🔍]

breaks.name: home-tiles-ignore-the-skin
breaks.why: Home's tiles paint their built-in glyph instead of the skin's, so every skin shows the same four tiles while SKINS and the Skin rows still differ

breaks.name: skin-rows-paint-one-badge
breaks.why: every Skin row paints the first skin's learn+play badge, so the rows on the Style sheet look alike while SKINS and Home still differ
